title: Param Dharam
desc: Savitri believes that her illegitimate child with her deceased lover, Vijay, was stillborn and did not survive. Years later, Savitri's world changes when she learns that her firstborn is alive.

title: Bade Dilwala
desc: After losing his daughter, Juhi, in a train accident, Sinha meets her husband, Vijay, and makes him his heir. Then a doctor shows up with an amnesiac Juhi and a dark secret about Vijay.

title: Preetam
desc: Raised by his aunt and uncle, orphaned Preetam grows up to become a man who cares for others; Preetam and Anil grow up like brothers, but dark undercurrents of a messy past threaten to destroy the solace and peace Preetam has in his present.

title: New Delhi
desc: An honest journalist is illegally detained in a mental asylum when he tries to expose two corrupt politicians. After his release, he plans to exact revenge on the people who wronged him.
